rulesStrings.li: physical_description_root->This plushie depicts a pink fluffy, which is either a tribute or a confession. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->A hand-stitched big fluffy plushie. You've paused the game to read this, haven't you? That's fine. The fluffies do it too. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->The plushie stares softly at the player. Not at the colonists. At you. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->This plushie was rated 'too soft' by the colony's safety inspector, who has since been reassigned to hauling. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->This plushie was meant to be life-sized, but the colony ran out of wool, room, and patience. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->Studies show colonists who own fluffy plushies are forty percent less likely to go berserk. The study was conducted by a fluffy. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->The tag reads: 'Do not shear. Do not milk. Do not ask where the real ones came from.' [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->A stuffed fluffy, lovingly made from wool shorn off an actual fluffy, who seemed fine with it. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->This plushie depicts [image]. Somehow it is still mostly fluff. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->The artist insists this is not a fluffy plushie. It is 'a statement about rum'. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->If you squeeze this plushie, it makes a sound like a hare who has made poor choices. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->This plushie is the reason the storyteller hasn't sent a raid in a while. Probably. Don't check. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->Somewhere, a mod author is very proud of this plushie. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->This plushie is worth more than some colonists. The raiders know. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->Of all the things to spend nine thousand work units on, the colony chose this. It was the correct choice. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->This plushie has been quietly judging the colony's prison since the day it was installed. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->A slightly lumpy big fluffy plushie, as if it ate something on the way here. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->The plushie is embroidered with the words 'I survived the Megasloth Incident'. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->A plushie of a pink fluffy. It is not alive. It is not alive. It is probably not alive. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->The plushie's tiny stitched smile suggests it knows exactly how many real fluffies the colony now has, and that the number is too many. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->This plushie depicts a fluffy mid-nuzzle. Colonists report feeling nuzzled just by looking at it. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->The artist sewed a tiny pack onto this plushie's back, because every fluffy deserves to carry the colony's problems. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->A big fluffy plushie, rendered in loving detail, except the face, which the artist 'got bored of'. [desc_sentence_group]
physical_description_root->If you're reading this description instead of building defenses, the plushie approves. [desc_sentence_group]
